1.name: Bestial Bond
1.description: Appeal to the senses of a target beast, bonding it to your side.

1.name: Call Companion
1.description: Beckon to your pet, calling it to your side.

1.name: Enraging Strike I
1.description: Strike your target in a furious rage, dealing 110% Weapon Ratio Damage and increasing the Strength, Dexterity, and Agility of both you and your pet by 2 for 30 seconds. This ability shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

effects.stat: Agility of both you and your pet
effects.display: +2 Agility of both you and your pet

1.valuesSummary: +2 STR/DEX/Agility of both you/pet/Agility of both you and your pet · 110% weapon dmg

1.name: Revive Companion
1.description: Rally your pet, returning it to life and restoring 20% Health.

1.name: Fear Beast
1.description: Fear a target beast, causing them to flee for 18 seconds. This spell has a slight chance to be removed by damage.

2.name: Predatory Instinct
2.description: Awaken the hunter's instinct in your group, increasing their Offense by 5 and Agility by 1 (L1) to 15 (L60). This ability persists until canceled. (Formerly Pack of the Predator.)
2.valuesSummary: +1–15 Offense by 5 and Agility (L1–L60) · +1–15 Agility (L1–L60) · +5 Offense

3.name: Kick
3.description: Swiftly kick your target, interrupting their casting and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 4 seconds.

4.name: Guardian Spirit
4.description: Invoke your pet's guardian spirit, reducing their Physical Damage received by 10% and increasing their Threat generation by 25% for 1 hour. (Defensive Spirit; only one Spirit buff may be active at a time.)

4.name: Lull Minor Beast
4.description: Lull a target beast, reducing their Aggro Radius for 2 minutes. This spell has a very slight chance to end early. Limited to beasts up to level 22.

4.name: Sooth Companion
4.description: Soothe your pet, restoring 10 Health and an additional 10 Health every 6 seconds for 12 seconds.

5.name: Lick Wounds
5.description: Pause to mend your wounds, restoring 5% Health at the cost of 5 (L1) to 50 (L60) Mana every second over 4 seconds. This ability is channeled. (Best used out of combat.)

5.name: Savage Strike I
5.description: Savagely strike your target, dealing 110% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L1) to 15 (L10) Physical Damage. Gains a damage bonus if the target is bleeding. Shares a cooldown with other Might abilities. (Bleed can come from your pet with a Spirit buff, or from Rogues/Archers.)

6.name: Pounce
6.description: Leap toward your target, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage and increasing the movement speed of your pet by 75% for 10 seconds. (Helps the pet keep up.)

7.name: Chop I
7.description: Viciously chop your target, dealing 120% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 10 (L7) to 15 (L17) Physical Damage, and creating an opening that causes your pet to land Critical Hits for 5 seconds. Requires a two-handed weapon. Shares a cooldown with other Martial abilities.

8.name: Remedy Companion
8.description: Remedy your pet, restoring 20 Health and an additional 20 Health every 6 seconds for 12 seconds.

8.name: Savage Spirit
8.description: Awaken a savage spirit within your pet, increasing their Attack Speed by 10% and granting them a chance to activate Rip on melee attacks for 1 hour. Rip: Rip the flesh of your target, dealing 10 Bleed Damage every 6 seconds for 30 seconds. (Offensive Spirit; only one Spirit buff may be active at a time.)

9.name: Command: Kill
9.description: Command your pet into action, calling on them to perform a devastating attack. (Shares a cooldown with other Command abilities.)

10.name: Enraging Strike II
10.description: Strike your opponent in a furious rage, dealing 120% Weapon Ratio Damage and increasing the Strength, Dexterity, and Agility of both you and your pet by 4 for 30 seconds. Shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

effects.stat: Agility of both you and your pet

10.name: Maul I
10.description: Violently maul your target, dealing 60% Weapon Ratio Damage per equipped weapon and decreasing their Physical Damage dealt by 5% for 5 seconds. Shares a cooldown with other Martial abilities. (Preferred for claws / dual-wield.)

12.name: Bestial Glimpse
12.description: Bind your vision to that of a target beast, granting you the ability to see through their eyes.

12.name: Invigorate Companion
12.description: Reinvigorate the bond with your pet, instantly resetting their abilities and your Command: Kill and Command: Protect abilities.

12.name: Patch Companion
12.description: Patch your pet, restoring 40 Health and an additional 40 Health every 6 seconds for 12 seconds.

15.name: Savage Strike II

16.name: Preservation
16.description: Preserve a target beast corpse, returning it to life. Inflicts Resurrection Illness on the target, reducing all of their stats for 3 minutes. Limited to targets up to level 27.

16.name: Shrink Companion
16.description: Shrink your pet, reducing their overall size by 20% for 35 minutes. This spell stacks up to two times.

17.name: Chop II

entries.description: Imbue your sight with predatory clarity, greatly enhancing your vision in darkness while reducing it in bright light for 1 hour. (Ultravision equivalent.)

entries.name: Savage Strike V
entries.description: Savagely strike your target, dealing 150% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 50 (L40) to 55 (L50) Physical Damage. Gains a damage bonus if the target is bleeding. Shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

entries.name: Chop V
entries.description: Viciously chop your target, dealing 225% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 50 (L47) to 55 (L57) Physical Damage, and creating an opening that causes your pet to land Critical Hits for 5 seconds. Requires a two-handed weapon. Shares a cooldown with other Martial abilities.

entries.name: Hunter's Chase
entries.description: Embody a predator in relentless pursuit, increasing your Movement Speed by 100% for 1 minute. This ability can only be used outdoors. (Formerly Speed of the Predator.)

entries.name: Maul V
entries.description: Violently maul your target, dealing 80% Weapon Ratio Damage per equipped weapon and decreasing their Physical Damage dealt by 5% for 5 seconds. Requires dual-wielded weapons. Shares a cooldown with other Martial abilities.

entries.name: Call of the Faithful
entries.description: Call out to your stowed pets from a great distance, summoning one to replace your current pet. (Late-game remote pet swap without needing a Kennel Master.)

entries.name: Enraging Strike VI
entries.description: Strike your target in a furious rage, dealing 170% Weapon Ratio Damage and increasing the Strength, Dexterity, and Agility of both you and your pet by 16 for 30 seconds. Shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

effects.stat: Agility of both you and your pet
effects.display: +16 Agility of both you and your pet

entries.name: Lull Greater Beasts
entries.description: Lull a target beast, reducing their Aggro Radius for 2 minutes. This spell has a very slight chance to end early. Limited to targets up to level 60.

entries.name: Rejuvenate Companion
entries.description: Rejuvenate your pet, restoring 240 Health and an additional 240 Health every 6 seconds for 12 seconds.

entries.name: Renewal of the Wild
entries.description: Renew a target beast corpse, returning it to life. Inflicts Resurrection Illness on the target, reducing all of their stats for 3 minutes. Limited to targets up to level 60.

entries.name: Mangle IV
entries.description: Mangle your target, dealing 275% Weapon Ratio Damage and reducing incoming healing effects by 50% for 30 seconds. Requires a two-handed weapon. Shares a cooldown with other Martial abilities.

entries.name: Cleanse Companion
entries.description: Purify your pet, removing two Disease and two Poison effects.

entries.name: Savage Strike VI
entries.description: Savagely strike your target, dealing 170% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 60 (L50) to 65 (L60) Physical Damage. Gains a damage bonus if the target is bleeding. Shares a cooldown with other Might abilities.

entries.name: Untamed Spirit
entries.description: Awaken an untamed spirit within your pet, increasing their Attack Speed by 40%, Agility by 15, and granting them a chance to activate Rip on melee attacks for 1 hour. Rip: Rip the flesh of your target, dealing 10 Physical Damage every 6 seconds for 30 seconds. This spell is considered a Primary Haste.

entries.name: Maul VI
entries.description: Violently maul your target, dealing 90% Weapon Ratio Damage per equipped weapon and decreasing their Physical Damage dealt by 5% for 5 seconds. Requires dual-wielded weapons. Shares a cooldown with other Martial abilities.
